<USER_QUERY>
which states and union territories are within 100 km of Gorakhpur?
</USER_QUERY>

WITH a AS
    (SELECT ST_Buffer(geometry, 100000 / 111320.0) AS geom
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = '9e7920a8-3e44-49fe-a9e4-ba019e844e4d')
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b,
     a
WHERE b.id != '9e7920a8-3e44-49fe-a9e4-ba019e844e4d'
    AND b.subtype = 'region'
    AND ST_Intersects(b.geometry, a.geom)

WITH a AS
    (SELECT geometry
     FROM read_parquet('divisions_area')
     WHERE id = 'c9f20d34-580d-4081-89a5-b80ed75f0897')
SELECT b.id,
       b.names."primary" AS name,
       b.subtype,
       ST_Area(b.geometry) AS area,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS geometry
FROM read_parquet('divisions_area') AS b,
     a
WHERE b.id != 'c9f20d34-580d-4081-89a5-b80ed75f0897'
    AND b.subtype = 'county'
    AND ST_Within(b.geometry, a.geometry)
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
